observations: Google Calendar iPhone/iPad app supports finding, creating, editing and responding to events offline after online setup/sign-in/sync.
Changes do not synchronize with other calendars until connectivity returns; guests cannot be emailed offline.
bounds: Google app only; no unlimited cached history, conflict resolution or propagation deadline specified.

observations: Mobile-browser guidance distinguishes viewing previously synchronized events from creating/editing, which require internet.
Mobile web does not support notifications; browser data may be stored locally.
bounds: Do not infer every browser guarantees offline access. Browser support and actual saved data require checking; not Cloud app behavior.
